name: Clackamas County, OR
findings: Clackamas County has 1,261 nonprofit organizations. 578 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 462 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Clackamas County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
28% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Few arts and cultural organizations list public events
observations.text: 7 arts and cultural organizations here list public events. In similar places of this size, about 16 would.

confidence.text: Based on 16 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for public events through arts and cultural groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 72 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
